scope: FreiHAND-only WiLoR reconstruction; official-code precedence for implemented components
correction: Official checkpoint config DOES publish all 14 mixture weights and augmentation magnitudes. Earlier claims these are unpublished were incorrect.

data.grouping: original capture ID modulo 32560; all four variants in same split; seed42
data.remaining_unknown: WiLoR original raw-to-unified-label conversion scripts and exact epoch construction are not released
data.prior: sample independently from training-only FreiHAND poses/shapes; avoid holdout leakage
data.betas_reg: false locally; official true has no effect on fully annotated FreiHAND samples

augmentation.translation_note: Official config TRANS_AUG_RATE=.5 is unused by official do_augmentation; x/y offsets are drawn every augmented sample. Keep official behavior.

training.reason: Keep official batch-summed supervised gradient / DDP rank average invariant relative to 8x128; mean adversarial losses unscaled
training.refinenet_note: Released get_parameters only lists backbone; local includes RefineNet so the stated learned refinement is actually trained. Not copied literally.
training.smoke: 2x512, one real batch + validation succeeded; resume succeeded; both optimizer step counts=2 after resume

evaluation.online: internal grouped holdout, PA joint/vertex errors and aligned mesh F@5/F@15; extra raw metrics diagnostic only
evaluation.benchmark: 3960 official samples with official ground-truth joints and vertices
evaluation.metadata: HaMeR official freihand_val.npz; fixed center and bbox, no test labels used as network input
evaluation.scorer: Pinned unmodified official FreiHAND metric function bodies; cKDTree replaces obsolete Open3D nearest-neighbor API
evaluation.metric_test: PA joints/vertices and F-scores agree with online torch metrics
evaluation.unknown: WiLoR exact benchmark preprocessing/checkpoint selection not published; upstream HaMeR eval pipeline used

official_weight_benchmark_result.input_processing: HaMeR official eval metadata; WiLoR crop tools; BBOX_SHAPE=[192,256]
official_weight_benchmark_result.caveat: WiLoR does not publish a benchmark entrypoint; exact original eval preprocessing is not confirmed

evaluation.unresolved_result_gap: Official released checkpoint with upstream preprocessing is close but not identical to the paper. Do not infer exact preprocessing/checkpoint equality.

published_recipe_conflicts: Paper: Adam; code: AdamW. Use code.
Paper: 1000 epochs; shipped config TOTAL_STEPS=1000000; author: batch1024, shipped per-rank batch32. Use paper epochs and author effective batch; original epoch size remains unknown.
local_choices: Training-only discriminator prior, one prior per image
Checkpoint/log intervals use Lightning optimizer-step counter; generator and discriminator each increment it
